outcome.answer: Several papers study reinforcement-learning self-play in strategy games. [1] trains a Generals.io agent using policy-gradient self-play and reports superhuman play. [2] adapts AlphaZero self-play to asymmetric Tablut, using separate policy and value heads for each player role. [3] develops self-play reinforcement learning and search for Stratego with hidden information, and applies related techniques to other games. [5] uses PPO self-play in a physics-based badminton environment, while [8] presents a memory-efficient self-play algorithm for two-player zero-sum Markov games.
